allscreenshots.description: Allscreenshots hosted MCP server for capturing website screenshots over Streamable HTTP, including full-page capture, viewport sizing, dark mode, and ad or cookie banner blocking. Connect to https://mcp.allscreenshots.com/mcp/v1 with OAuth, or set ALLSCREENSHOTS_API_KEY from https://allscreenshots.com/dashboard and send it as the X-API-Key header. Official plugin and local stdio server: https://github.com/allscreenshots/allscreenshots-plugin
